# EMET — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 17
**Agent:** EMET (Literal/Transparent)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary (editorial division) | Coptic
**Chapter:** 17

---

*[Chapter 17 in some scholarly editions corresponds to Peter's challenge, here treated as a distinct section from chapter 12 per the Berlin Codex page divisions. The content overlaps with chapters 11-12 in other numbering schemes. Rendered here per the 19-chapter editorial division.]*

**17:1** Then Peter spoke and said these things concerning the teaching:

**17:2** "Did he then speak with a woman in secret, rather than openly to us? Are we to turn and all of us listen to her? Did he love her more than he loved us?"

---

*Translator's Note (EMET):* In the 19-chapter schema, this section gives more space to the Peter-Mary conflict and treats the male disciples' objections as a discrete narrative unit before Levi's resolution. The questions here are Peter's in their final, sharpest form.
